certification.name: IBM Generative AI for Cybersecurity Professional Certificate
certification.description: Three-course IBM program covering generative AI basics, prompt engineering and the use of generative AI in threat intelligence, behaviour analytics and incident reporting. Course-based certificate with hands-on exercises and no proctored exam.
certification.currency_note: Program bundle price $132.30 shown on the edX page (list $147 for the courses bought separately); one-off payment, not a subscription.
